tools.name: capture_js_console_logs
tools.description: Capture one-shot React Native or Expo JS console events through the Metro inspector WebSocket.

tools.name: capture_js_network_events
tools.description: Capture one-shot React Native or Expo JS network events through the Metro inspector WebSocket.

tools.name: capture_element_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot cropped to a specific UI element's bounds for visual regression testing.

tools.name: compare_against_baseline
tools.description: Compare the current action outcome against a previously successful local baseline.

tools.name: compare_visual_baseline
tools.description: Compare a current screenshot against a visual baseline image, returning pixel-diff percentage and pass/fail status.

tools.name: collect_debug_evidence
tools.description: Capture AI-friendly summarized debug evidence from logs and crash signals, with optional diagnostics escalation.

tools.name: collect_diagnostics
tools.description: Capture an Android bugreport bundle or an iOS simulator diagnostics bundle.

tools.name: detect_interruption
tools.description: Detect interruption signals from current state summary and UI evidence.

tools.name: classify_interruption
tools.description: Classify interruption type and confidence from structured interruption signals.

tools.name: describe_capabilities
tools.description: Return the current platform capability profile before invoking platform-specific tools.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check command availability and device readiness.

tools.name: execute_intent
tools.description: Execute a high-level intent by planning a bounded mobile action with evidence.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Execute a bounded multi-step task plan and return per-step outcomes.

tools.name: start_record_session
tools.description: Start passive recording for manual interactions on Android or iOS targets.

tools.name: get_record_session_status
tools.description: Get passive recording session status, counts, and warnings.

tools.name: end_record_session
tools.description: Stop passive recording, map captured events, and export replayable flow.

tools.name: cancel_record_session
tools.description: Cancel an active passive recording session.

tools.name: export_session_flow
tools.description: Export persisted session action records to a replayable Maestro flow YAML.

tools.name: record_task_flow
tools.description: Export a task-oriented flow snapshot from persisted session actions.

tools.name: request_manual_handoff
tools.description: Record an explicit operator handoff checkpoint for OTP, consent, captcha, or protected-page workflows.

tools.name: explain_last_failure
tools.description: Explain the most recent action failure using deterministic attribution heuristics.

tools.name: find_similar_failures
tools.description: Find locally indexed failures that resemble the current failure signature.

tools.name: get_action_outcome
tools.description: Load a previously recorded action outcome by actionId.

tools.name: get_crash_signals
tools.description: Capture recent Android crash or ANR evidence and inspect the iOS simulator crash reporter tree.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Capture recent Android logcat output or recent iOS simulator logs.

tools.name: get_screen_summary
tools.description: Capture a compact current-screen summary with actionable targets and blocking signals.

tools.name: get_session_state
tools.description: Return compact AI-first session state with latest screen, readiness, and recent failure signals.

tools.name: inspect_ui
tools.description: Capture a device UI hierarchy dump; iOS still relies on idb-backed hierarchy artifacts.

tools.name: query_ui
tools.description: Query Android or iOS hierarchy dumps by selector fields and return structured matches.

tools.name: resolve_ui_target
tools.description: Resolve a UI selector to a single actionable Android or iOS target or report ambiguity.

tools.name: scroll_and_resolve_ui_target
tools.description: Scroll Android UI containers while trying to resolve a selector to a single actionable target. iOS: use scroll_only → wait_for_ui → resolve_ui_target instead.

tools.name: scroll_only
tools.description: Perform scroll gestures without target resolution. Use with wait_for_ui and resolve_ui_target for explicit control.

tools.name: scroll_and_tap_element
tools.description: Scroll Android UI containers until a target resolves, then tap the resolved element. iOS: use scroll_only → wait_for_ui → tap_element instead.

tools.name: install_app
tools.description: Install a native or flutter artifact onto a target device/simulator.

tools.name: list_js_debug_targets
tools.description: Discover React Native or Expo JS debug targets from the Metro inspector endpoint.

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Launch the selected app or Expo URL on a target device/simulator.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List Android devices and iOS simulators/physical devices.

tools.name: measure_android_performance
tools.description: Capture an Android Perfetto time window and return a lightweight AI-friendly performance summary.

tools.name: measure_ios_performance
tools.description: Capture an iOS xctrace time window and return a lightweight AI-friendly performance summary.

tools.name: navigate_back
tools.description: Navigate back using platform-specific mechanisms: Android KEYEVENT_BACK or iOS app back button tap.

tools.name: perform_action_with_evidence
tools.description: Execute one bounded action and automatically capture pre/post state plus outcome evidence.

tools.name: rank_failure_candidates
tools.description: Rank likely failure layers for the latest attributed action window.

tools.name: record_screen
tools.description: Record screen output on Android (adb) or iOS simulator (simctl) for a bounded duration.

tools.name: recover_to_known_state
tools.description: Attempt a bounded deterministic recovery such as wait-ready or app relaunch.

tools.name: resolve_interruption
tools.description: Resolve interruption with policy-aware signature matching and bounded actions.

tools.name: resume_interrupted_action
tools.description: Replay interrupted action from checkpoint with drift detection.

tools.name: replay_last_stable_path
tools.description: Replay the latest successful bounded action recorded for this session.

tools.name: replay_checkpoint_chain
tools.description: Replay a chain of low-risk actions from the last stable checkpoint in a session, with divergence detection.

tools.name: reset_app_state
tools.description: Reset app state using clear_data, uninstall_reinstall, or keychain_reset strategy.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot from a target device or simulator.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Perform a coordinate tap on Android, iOS simulators through idb, or iOS physical devices through a generated Maestro action flow.

tools.name: tap_element
tools.description: Resolve a UI selector to a single Android or iOS target and tap only when the match is unambiguous.

tools.name: terminate_app
tools.description: Terminate the selected app on a target device or simulator.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Perform direct text input on Android, iOS simulators through idb, or iOS physical devices through a generated Maestro action flow.

tools.name: type_into_element
tools.description: Resolve a UI selector, focus the matched Android or iOS element, and type text.

tools.name: validate_flow
tools.description: Validate a Maestro flow or recorded session against the current app state without executing actions.

tools.name: wait_for_ui
tools.description: Poll the Android or iOS hierarchy until a selector matches or timeout is reached.

tools.name: wait_for_ui_stable
tools.description: Poll the UI hierarchy until consecutive snapshots produce the same structural hash, indicating the UI has stopped animating.

tools.name: probe_network_readiness
tools.description: Probe network readiness on Android or iOS device, returning connectivity status, latency, DNS health, backend reachability, and a recovery strategy recommendation.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Create a typed mobile execution session.

tools.name: run_flow
tools.description: Run the selected flow through the Maestro adapter.

tools.name: suggest_known_remediation
tools.description: Suggest remediation based on similar failures, local baselines, and built-in readiness skill routing.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: Close a session and return final metadata.
